chosen_premises: A study at the High-Anchor Orbital Elevator revealed that high-gravity mass prayer generates an electromagnetic field that fries vital life-support telemetry, though the bishop proudly declared it a minor trade-off for 'unprecedentedly crisp' spiritual resonance.

Astrophysicists at the Equatorial Elevator Terminus successfully captured the radio frequency of Paradise, revealing it to be a sound of sheer, unending cosmic terror, though clergy are overcome with pride because the pitch perfectly auto-tunes their ceremonial organ.

Researchers on the Low-Orbit Ring Station discovered that a localized divine miracle is disintegrating living quarters floor by floor, yet residents refuse to halt the ritual because the resulting ash cloud yields 'truly breathtaking' nostalgic sunsets.

Antiquarians at the Vesta Ring Terminus proved that the station’s venerated founder-saint was merely an automated floor-buffing unit from 2400, prompting emotional citizens to hold sobbing, tearful vigils whenever modern cleaning drones run low on battery.
